crossRefs.note: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

translations.web: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!
translations.bsb: For as soon as the sound of your greeting reached my ears, the baby in my womb leaped for joy.
translations.kjv: For, lo, as soon as the voice of thy salutation sounded in mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
translations.asv: For behold, when the voice of thy salutation came into mine ears, the babe leaped in my womb for joy.
